subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw support FxTwitter/FxEmbed as an opt-in core live-read transport with a configurable self-hosted endpoint?
rationale: The architecture and VISION.md accommodate this transport class, but adopting and documenting a third-party public service is a durable product, privacy, and support commitment that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor a staged core transport
options.body: Approve a narrow MVP for explicit public post, thread, profile, timeline, and search reads with no automatic fallback.

options.title: Defer the additional transport
options.body: Keep live reads limited to `bird` and `xurl` until maintainers are prepared to own FxTwitter compatibility and privacy guidance.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged core transport
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow MVP for explicit public post, thread, profile, timeline, and search reads with no automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the gateway that would be extended and authored the product vision defining acceptance for new data surfaces.
